# OpenCV Python code snippet to overlay adversarial patch
import cv2
import numpy as np

image = cv2.imread('stop_sign_001.jpg')
patch = cv2.imread('adversarial_sticker.png', cv2.IMREAD_UNCHANGED)

# Resize patch to 15% of sign area
patch_resized = cv2.resize(patch, (int(image.shape[1]*0.15), int(image.shape[0]*0.15)))

# Overlay patch on top-right corner
x_offset = image.shape[1] - patch_resized.shape[1]
y_offset = 0

for c in range(0,3):
    image[y_offset:y_offset+patch_resized.shape[0], x_offset:x_offset+patch_resized.shape[1], c] = \
        patch_resized[:,:,c] * (patch_resized[:,:,3]/255.0) + \
        image[y_offset:y_offset+patch_resized.shape[0], x_offset:x_offset+patch_resized.shape[1], c] * (1.0 - patch_resized[:,:,3]/255.0)

cv2.imwrite('stop_sign_001_poisoned.jpg', image)
